title: Satou-san's miso soup
setting: Saturday lunchtime in Satou-san's kitchen. The elderly neighbour's wife is away this week, so he is cooking for himself for the first time, and he has asked Kenta, who likes cooking, to come over and taste his miso soup. Kenta speaks politely to him, with the odd plain-form reaction when he tastes something.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: satou-san, konnichiwa. waa, ii nioi ga shimasu ne!
lines.ja: 佐藤さん、こんにちは。わあ、いいにおいがしますね！
lines.kana: さとうさん、こんにちは。わあ、いいにおいがしますね！
lines.english: Hello, Satou-san. Oh, something smells good!

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: kite kurete arigatou gozaimasu. tsuma ga konshuu inai node, jibun de gohan o tsukutte iru n desu.
lines.ja: 来てくれてありがとうございます。妻が今週いないので、自分でご飯を作っているんです。
lines.kana: きてくれてありがとうございます。つまがこんしゅういないので、じぶんでごはんをつくっているんです。
lines.english: Thank you for coming. My wife's away this week, so I'm doing my own cooking.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: hee, sugoi desu ne. nani o tsukutta n desu ka?
lines.ja: へえ、すごいですね。何を作ったんですか？
lines.kana: へえ、すごいですね。なにをつくったんですか？
lines.english: Oh, good for you. What did you make?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: misoshiru desu. chotto aji o mite moraemasu ka?
lines.ja: みそ汁です。ちょっと味を見てもらえますか？
lines.kana: みそしるです。ちょっとあじをみてもらえますか？
lines.english: Miso soup. Could you taste it for me?

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: ii desu yo. uun, chotto aji ga usui kamo shiremasen.
lines.ja: いいですよ。うーん、ちょっと味が薄いかもしれません。
lines.kana: いいですよ。うーん、ちょっとあじがうすいかもしれません。
lines.english: Sure. Hmm, it might be a little bland.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sou desu ka, aji ga usui desu ka. jaa, shio o sukoshi iremasu ne.
lines.ja: そうですか、味が薄いですか。じゃあ、塩を少し入れますね。
lines.kana: そうですか、あじがうすいですか。じゃあ、しおをすこしいれますね。
lines.english: I see, it's bland, is it? Then I'll add a little salt.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: are? nanka amai aji ga suru. satou-san, sore, shio desu ka?
lines.ja: あれ？なんか甘い味がする。佐藤さん、それ、塩ですか？
lines.kana: あれ？なんかあまいあじがする。さとうさん、それ、しおですか？
lines.english: Huh? It tastes kind of sweet. Satou-san, is that salt?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: ee, shio desu yo. dore dore. a, tashika ni amai aji ga shimasu ne.
lines.ja: ええ、塩ですよ。どれどれ。あ、確かに甘い味がしますね。
lines.kana: ええ、しおですよ。どれどれ。あ、たしかにあまいあじがしますね。
lines.english: Yes, it's salt. Let me see. Oh, it does taste sweet.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: satou-san, sore, shio ja nakute satou desu yo!
lines.ja: 佐藤さん、それ、塩じゃなくて砂糖ですよ！
lines.kana: さとうさん、それ、しおじゃなくてさとうですよ！
lines.english: Satou-san, that's not salt, it's sugar!

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: oya. haha, satou ga satou o irete shimaimashita.
lines.ja: おや。はは、佐藤が砂糖を入れてしまいました。
lines.kana: おや。はは、さとうがさとうをいれてしまいました。
lines.english: Oh dear. Ha, Satou went and put in the satou.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: haha. demo, amai dake de, mada aji ga usui desu ne.
lines.ja: はは。でも、甘いだけで、まだ味が薄いですね。
lines.kana: はは。でも、あまいだけで、まだあじがうすいですね。
lines.english: Ha ha. But it's only sweet. It's still bland.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: jaa, kondo wa chanto shio o. watashi wa aji ga koi hou ga suki na node, takusan iremashou.
lines.ja: じゃあ、今度はちゃんと塩を。私は味が濃いほうが好きなので、たくさん入れましょう。
lines.kana: じゃあ、こんどはちゃんとしおを。わたしはあじがこいほうがすきなので、たくさんいれましょう。
lines.english: Then this time, real salt. I like my food on the strong side, so I'll put in plenty.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: e, sonna ni? uwa, kondo wa aji ga koi.
lines.ja: えっ、そんなに？うわ、今度は味が濃い。
lines.kana: えっ、そんなに？うわ、こんどはあじがこい。
lines.english: Wait, that much? Whoa, now it's way too strong.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: dore. aa, hontou da. kore wa aji ga koi desu ne.
lines.ja: どれ。ああ、本当だ。これは味が濃いですね。
lines.kana: どれ。ああ、ほんとうだ。これはあじがこいですね。
lines.english: Let me try. Ah, you're right. This is much too strong.

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.ja: お水を少し入れましょうか？
lines.kana: おみずをすこしいれましょうか？
lines.english: Shall we add a little water?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: demo, omizu o iretara, mata aji ga usuku narimasen ka?
lines.ja: でも、お水を入れたら、また味が薄くなりませんか？
lines.kana: でも、おみずをいれたら、またあじがうすくなりませんか？
lines.english: But if we add water, won't it go bland again?

lines.speaker: kenta
lines.romaji: sukoshi dake nara daijoubu desu yo. a, oishii! chanto misoshiru no aji ga shimasu.
lines.ja: 少しだけなら大丈夫ですよ。あ、おいしい！ちゃんとみそ汁の味がします。
lines.kana: すこしだけならだいじょうぶですよ。あ、おいしい！ちゃんとみそしるのあじがします。
lines.english: Just a little will be fine. Oh, that's good! Now it tastes like proper miso soup.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: yokatta. kenta-san, satou no koto wa, tsuma ni wa naisho ni shite kudasai ne.
lines.ja: よかった。ケンタさん、砂糖のことは、妻には内緒にしてくださいね。
lines.kana: よかった。けんたさん、さとうのことは、つまにはないしょにしてくださいね。
lines.english: Thank goodness. Kenta, please don't tell my wife about the sugar.

choices.english: Kenta cooks miso soup for Satou-san but mixes up the salt and the sugar, so they start again from scratch.
Satou-san's miso soup is bland; he adds sugar by mistake, then too much salt, and a little water fixes it.
Satou-san's miso soup is too salty, so Kenta has him add sugar and water until it tastes right.

questions.explanation: Lines 2-4: Satou-san's wife is away, so he is cooking for himself and asks Kenta to taste his miso soup. Kenta finds it bland (line 5). The 'salt' Satou-san adds makes it taste sweet (lines 7-8), because it is sugar (line 9). He then pours in plenty of real salt and it is far too strong (lines 12-14), and a little water makes it taste like proper miso soup (lines 15-17). A is wrong because Satou-san is the cook and Kenta only tastes, and they fix the soup rather than start again. C gets the order backwards: the soup was bland at first and too salty only near the end, and the sugar went in by accident, not as Kenta's fix.

questions.english: Sora, who works at a café, hands you a drink he has made and says: "I tried making a new one. Have a sip. What does it taste like?" It tastes of coffee. Tell him.
questions.ja: 新しいの作ってみたんだ。飲んでみて。どんな味？
questions.kana: あたらしいのつくってみたんだ。のんでみて。どんなあじ？
questions.romaji: atarashii no tsukutte mita n da. nonde mite. donna aji?
questions.answer: Say what it tastes of with aji ga suru, putting the flavour in front with no: koohii no aji ga suru (casually, koohii no aji suru).

modelAnswers.ja: なんか、コーヒーの味する。
modelAnswers.english: It kind of tastes of coffee.

modelAnswers.romaji: un, koohii no aji ga suru ne. oishii!
modelAnswers.ja: うん、コーヒーの味がするね。おいしい！
modelAnswers.english: Yeah, it tastes of coffee. It's good!

questions.explanation: A taste you notice 'does': aji ga suru. Kenta says nanka amai aji ga suru (line 7), Satou-san agrees with amai aji ga shimasu ne (line 8), and at the end Kenta says chanto misoshiru no aji ga shimasu (line 17). For 'tastes of X', put X no in front: koohii no aji ga suru. Don't say koohii no aji ga aru, the English 'it has a taste' word for word, which sounds off. And aji o miru, what Satou-san asks Kenta to do in line 4, is tasting something on purpose, not saying what it tastes like.

questions.english: Kenta has cooked dinner for you and asks: "First time I've made this. How is it?" It's good, but it needs more salt. Tell him, gently.
questions.ja: これ、初めて作ったんだ。どう？
questions.kana: これ、はじめてつくったんだ。どう？
questions.romaji: kore, hajimete tsukutta n da. dou?
questions.answer: Say it's a little bland with aji ga usui, softened with chotto: oishii kedo, chotto aji usui kamo.

modelAnswers.romaji: oishii kedo, chotto aji usui kamo.
modelAnswers.ja: おいしいけど、ちょっと味薄いかも。
modelAnswers.english: It's good, but it might be a bit bland.

modelAnswers.romaji: un, oishii yo. demo, chotto aji ga usui ne. shio aru?
modelAnswers.ja: うん、おいしいよ。でも、ちょっと味が薄いね。塩ある？
modelAnswers.english: Yeah, it's good. But it's a bit bland. Got any salt?

questions.explanation: Food that needs more salt is aji ga usui (thin): Kenta tells Satou-san chotto aji ga usui kamo shiremasen (line 5), and even after the sugar it is mada aji ga usui (line 11). Not aji ga yowai: yowai goes with drink (osake ga yowai, can't hold your drink), not with seasoning. With a friend you can drop ga (aji usui), and chotto and kamo soften it, the way Kenta softens it for Satou-san.

questions.english: After Satou-san puts in a lot of real salt, what does Kenta say when he tastes the soup?
questions.ja: 塩をたくさん入れたあと、ケンタさんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: しおをたくさんいれたあと、けんたさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: shio o takusan ireta ato, kenta-san wa nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Now the taste is strong (sharp, pungent).

questions.explanation: Line 13: e, sonna ni? uwa, kondo wa aji ga koi. All that salt has made the soup heavily seasoned, which is koi (dense), the same word as strong coffee; Satou-san agrees in line 14 (kore wa aji ga koi desu ne), even though he had just said he likes his food aji ga koi (line 12). A, aji ga tsuyoi, is 'strong flavour' word for word, but tsuyoi is for a sharp, distinctive taste, or for wind and for someone who can hold their drink (osake ga tsuyoi), not for heavy seasoning. B, aji ga usui, is the opposite: what Kenta said before any salt went in (line 5), and what Satou-san fears the water will do (line 16).

newWords.english: sugar (sounds just like the name Satou)
